headline: Trump Fires Jobs Chief, Cries Rigged

beats.text: On August 1st, a weak jobs report landed. Hours later, Trump didn't blame the economy -- he fired the woman whose job was just to count it.

beats.caption: We had no confidence. I mean, the numbers were ridiculous what she announced.
beats.label: via CBS News

beats.text: Never happened before. Not once in the Bureau's history had a sitting commissioner been fired.

beats.caption: There's no way for that to happen.
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: That's Trump's own former BLS chief talking. The guy he appointed. Even he isn't buying the conspiracy.

beats.caption: I was commissioner, and I was sometimes locked out of the process.
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: For the rigging theory, Trump's team had one witness: his own economic adviser, pointing at revisions everybody already knew about.

beats.caption: The evidence is that there have been a bunch of revisions that could appear to partisans.
beats.label: via NBC

beats.text: Translation: no evidence, just vibes. PolitiFact rated the whole rigged claim Pants Fire.
